experiment: Native seismic self/shared neural splauts, 30–50 seconds
conclusion: The transferred optimizer remains all-self in the four primary windows. Extended spatial exploration activates shared sites and improves raw held-out power NMSE, but does not predict the time-varying calls. Geometry and independent-time-shuffle controls also activate sites. The native elephant calls have not been reliably separated or localized.

mapping.mapping_assumption: Available CSV TrackIndex values refer directly to WAV channels; absent tracks are excluded. This does not verify export ordering.

primary_protocol.preprocessing: Full original power; no floor subtraction; common fit-only numerical scale
primary_protocol.selection: Fixed final fit objective; no real-data hyperparameter selection; validation/test excluded from source fitting

optimization_diagnostic: On 38–46 s, first optimize with zero spatial penalty for 200 steps, then ramp to the original 0.08 by step 500. Selection always minimizes the same full final objective over all iterates including all-self. Loss weights are not selected by test scores.
station_protocol: 16 fit / 16 validation / 181 evaluation-only stations, selected by coordinates with seed 2026 within 500 m of acoustic M04; fitting, initialization and amplitudes never use validation or test spectra.
metrics: Shared-only station-balanced power NMSE and per-frequency temporally centered dynamic NMSE/correlation. Zero or constant dynamic prediction has dynamic NMSE 1. Total self+shared reconstruction is not separation evidence.

limitations: No native source identity, clean source waveform or surveyed elephant location ground truth
CSV has 1153 tracks vs 1024 WAV channels: direct available TrackIndex/channel ordering is assumed, not verified
Fixed 330 m/s point-source propagation, common spreading exponent and no learned station response
Exploratory analysis with overlapping windows, not a preregistered blind benchmark
Continuation and no-sparsity sensitivity trials cover only 38–46 s
next_experiment: Reserve a stationary noise floor for self and accept births only when they predict time-varying power at other fitting stations; verify TrackIndex mapping before native localization claims.
